info.title: Saveful for Business API
info.description:
Food rescue platform API. All routes are prefixed `/api/v1`.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint requires a bearer token unless marked otherwise. Obtain one from `POST /auth/login`, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Enterprise endpoints** additionally require the organisation to be on the Enterprise plan, and are gated on the caller’s Enterprise role and scope. A 403 carrying `MISSING_PERMISSION` means the role is wrong; one carrying `OUTSIDE_SCOPE` means the role is right but the target sits outside what the caller can reach.
